Preparing Sequencing Reagents from MiSeq Kit The Illumina in situ sequencing kit reagents are collected from MiSeq reagent kits. Both MiSeq v3 and v2 reagent kits can be used for in situ sequencing. The terminology below is written for the MiSeq v3, with MiSeq v2 terms in parentheses. Three reagents are collected: IMT: Incorporation Mix (v2: IMS, Incorporation Mix) USM: Scan Mix (v2: SRE, Scan Mix) CMS: Cleavage Mix (v2: CMS, Cleavage Mix) Defrost a MiSeq v3 reagent kit (either Overnight at 4 °C or for 01:00:00 in a Room temperature water bath). steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Primer Hybridization Mix
steps.instruction: Dilute the 100 μM sequencing primer stock (sequence: TCT CGG GAA CGC TGA AGA CGG C, HPLC purified) 1:40 in 4X SSC to create a 2.5 μM sequencing primer mix.

steps.title: Hybridize Sequencing Primer
steps.instruction: Incubate the gel with the 2.5 μM sequencing primer hybridization mix in 4X SSC for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Perform SSC Washes
steps.instruction: Wash gels with 4X SSC three times for 10 minutes each at 37 °C.

steps.title: Perform PR2 Washes
steps.instruction: Wash gel with PR2 buffer three times for 10 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: TdT Pre-incorporation
steps.instruction: Prepare TdT pre-incorporation mix and add to sample for 20 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Combine 20 μL 10X TdT buffer, 20 μL 2.5 mM CoCl2, 4 μL 2.5 mM each ddNTP, and 156 μL ddH2O to reach a total volume of 200 μL (Final concentrations: 1X TdT buffer, 250 μM CoCl2, 50 μM each ddNTP).

steps.title: Perform PBS Washes
steps.instruction: Wash gels with 1X PBS three times for 10 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: TdT Capping
steps.instruction: Prepare TdT reaction mix, add to sample, and incubate for 1.5 hours at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Combine 20 μL 10X TdT buffer, 20 μL 2.5 mM CoCl2, 4 μL 2.5 mM each ddNTP, and 156 μL ddH2O to reach a total volume of 200 μL (Final concentrations: 1X TdT buffer, 250 μM CoCl2, 50 μM each ddNTP).

steps.title: Clean Glass-Bottom Plate Surfaces
steps.instruction: Wash wells of a 24-well glass-bottom plate briefly with ddH2O, followed by 100% ethanol.

steps.title: Treat Plate with Bind-Silane
steps.instruction: Prepare Bind-Silane reaction mix and treat wells of the glass-bottom plate for 45 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mix: 10 μL Bind-Silane Reagent, 4000 μL Ethanol, 100 μL Glacial Acetic Acid, and 890 μL Water (Total 5000 μL).
Remove reaction mix and allow wells to dry.
Wash twice briefly with 100% ethanol, remove ethanol, and allow wells to dry completely.

steps.title: Prepare Re-embedding Gelling Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the re-embedding gelling solution by adding reagents in the specified order, vortexing after each chemical reagent (do not vortex after adding beads).

substeps.instruction: Add 875 μL Water, 100 μL 40% (w/v) Acrylamide/Bis 19:1 solution, 5 μL 1 M Tris Base, 5 μL 10% (w/v) TEMED, 5 μL 10% (w/v) APS, and 10 μL 0.2 μm TetraSpeck beads (Total 1000 μL).
Mix TetraSpeck beads by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Cast Second Re-embedding Gel
steps.instruction: Anchor the sample gel to the Bind-Silane treated plate using the re-embedding solution.

substeps.instruction: Pipette a droplet of re-embedding solution into a well.
Transfer sample gel to the well with a paintbrush, placing it on the droplet with the tissue facing up (farthest from glass).
Pipette another droplet of solution on top of the sample.
Place a 10 mm circular coverglass on top with tweezers.
Backfill remaining volume under the coverglass and around the gel using a pipette.

steps.title: Nitrogen Purge and Gelation
steps.instruction: Purge the plate with nitrogen and incubate to cast the gel.

substeps.instruction: Place the 24-well plate in a humidified Tupperware container with two small holes in the lid.
Purge with nitrogen gas via a blunt needle for 10 minutes (flow rate barely perceivable).
Withdraw needle and seal both holes with tape.
Incubate for 1.5 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Post-Gelation Wash
steps.instruction: Remove coverglass with tweezers and wash sample with 1X PBS three times for 20 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: Pre-incubate with Incorporation Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare ISS Incorporation Mix and wash the sample with it twice for 15 minutes each at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mix: 500 μL 1X IMT, 100 μL 25 mM MgCl2, 100 μL 10X Taq Reaction Buffer, and 300 μL ddH2O (Total 1000 μL; Final: 0.5X IMT, 2.5 mM MgCl2, 1X Taq Buffer).

steps.title: Perform Incorporation
steps.instruction: Treat sample with ISS Incorporation Mix for 10 minutes at 50 °C.

steps.title: Post-incorporation Washes
steps.instruction: Wash with 2% (w/v) Zwittergen in PR2 twice for 15 minutes each at 50 °C.

substeps.instruction: If harsher washing is needed, add 0.1 M MES buffer, pH 6.
Wash with PR2 for 15 minutes at 50 °C.

steps.title: DAPI Staining
steps.instruction: Stain with DAPI (1 mg/L) in PR2 for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Post-Imaging Washes
steps.instruction: Wash with PR2 buffer twice for 10 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: Pre-incubation with Cleavage Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash with CMS (cleavage buffer from Illumina Kit) twice for 10 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Cleavage
steps.instruction: Treat sample with CMS (cleavage buffer from Illumina Kit) for 20 minutes at 50 °C.

steps.title: Post-Cleavage Washes
steps.instruction: Wash with PR2 buffer twice for 10 minutes each (temperature not specified), then wash with PR2 buffer twice for 10 minutes each at room temperature.

steps.title: Recover Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: If biotinylated secondary antibody staining was performed, recover the signal (skip final cleavage if sub-voxel registration is required).

substeps.instruction: Wash samples with PR2 buffer for 30 minutes at room temperature (only if final cleavage was skipped).
Incubate samples with 10 μg/mL fluorophore-labeled Streptavidin (e.g., Streptavidin-Alexa 488) in PR2 overnight at 4 °C.
Wash samples with PR2 three times for 30 minutes each at room temperature.
Stain with DAPI (1 mg/L) in PR2 for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Imaging Preparation
steps.instruction: Wash samples with USM buffer (from Illumina kit) twice for 15 minutes each at room temperature, then keep the sample in USM buffer for imaging.

steps.title: Pool ddNTPs
steps.instruction: Combine 10 μL from each of the four 10 mM ddNTP tubes to form a final 2.5 mM each ddNTP pool.

description: Overview of Second Re-embedding To minimize any movement during the multiple rounds of imaging during in situ sequencing, the sample gel is immobilized to a glass-bottom plate for all subsequent steps. This is accomplished by functionalizing wells of a glass-bottom plate with acryloyl groups (Step 6), and casting a second re-embedding gel to anchor the gel to the plate (Step 7). Overview of Sequencing Preparation In this step, we prepare the glass-anchored sample for in situ sequencing with the Illumina chemistry. There are two primary steps here: (1) capping terminal 3' DNA ends of cellular DNA with dideoxy nucleotides; and (2) hybridization of the Illumina sequencing primer. Dideoxy Capping of 3' DNA Strands To minimize background from base addition to exposed 3' ends of cellular DNA during the Illumina incorporation, Terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase (TdT) is used to add dideoxynucleotides to block further extension. Overview The next three sections cover the process of in situ Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis. The first step is elongation, the addition of a new base (Step 12). The second step is imaging (Step 13). The third step is cleavage (Step 14). These steps are repeated for each base of the barcode. For the barcode structure described by this protocol, a total of seven rounds of sequencing are required. Overview In this step, the next base of the barcode is synthesized. This base is complementary to the template base of the barcode in the amplicon. Overview In this step, the Illumina reversible terminator is unblocked, allowing for synthesis of the next base. The fluorophore added with the last base is also cleaved off the sequencing product. Overview In this step, we transfer the sample to the Illumina imaging buffer and image the current round of the barcode.
